product_name: BitLendingClub / Loanbase peer-to-peer Bitcoin lending marketplace
custody_model: Centrally operated marketplace accounts and platform-mediated Bitcoin transfers between lenders and borrowers
yield_source: Interest paid by individual borrowers on marketplace loans
risk_notes: Lenders faced borrower default, platform custody, account security, identity-verification, jurisdiction, recovery, withdrawal, and platform-shutdown risk. The February 2016 account compromise and the later regulatory wind-down are separate risk events.

custody_model: Platform-mediated marketplace connecting global investors with small-business borrowers under regulated brokerage and servicing arrangements
yield_source: Interest and principal payments from SME borrowers
risk_notes: Marketplace lenders faced borrower credit, servicing, legal-entity, jurisdiction, platform-transition, liquidity, and recovery risk. Stopping new originations did not automatically settle the existing loan portfolio.

custody_model: Security-token claim against Bitbond Finance with token-holder rights defined by offering documents rather than ordinary marketplace lender terms
yield_source: Issuer coupon and redemption obligations supported in part by proceeds allocated to SME lending and other stated uses
risk_notes: BB1 issuer, coupon, maturity, subordination, loan-portfolio exposure, token transfer, custody, and investor-right risks differ from direct lending-marketplace claims. No completed redemption or uniform investor outcome is inferred.
